cues.text: I pack my things in the morning
I put my passport and ticket in
I go to the train station
And I look at my ticket
My train leaves in ten minutes
I need to find the platform quickly
Я в дороге, новый город впереди
I’m on the road, a new city ahead
Я не знаю, что там будет
I don’t know what will happen there
But I want to see it all
Я в дороге, и мне нравится путь
I’m on the road, and I like the journey
There are many people in the street
I take a taxi to the hotel
I walk up to the reception desk
У меня есть бронь на две ночи
I have a reservation for two nights
They give me the key to my room
Я в дороге, новый город впереди
I’m on the road, a new city ahead
Я не знаю, что там будет
I don’t know what will happen there
But I want to see it all
Я в дороге, и мне нравится путь
I’m on the road, and I like the journey
I leave my things in the room
I walk to the city center
I go into a small cafe
Then I return to the hotel
